overview_description.description: Ryft is the Automated Iceberg Management Solution. Ryft also automates governance, GDPR compliance and data lifecycle so data stays secure and compliant.

product.name: Ryft Data Platform
product.description: A managed Apache Iceberg data-management platform that automates table optimization, maintenance, governance, compliance, retention, backups, and disaster recovery across cloud lakehouse environments.

product.name: Ryft Context Layer
product.description: An agent-readable context layer for Apache Iceberg tables that combines schema, usage, query, ingestion, freshness, and statistical signals to help AI agents understand and access lakehouse data.
